title: polypodium obovatum
intro: Polypodium obovatum, commonly known as Leopard's Foot, is a species of fern belonging to the Polypodiaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium obovatum include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
